title: Maó Opera Season
description: The Teatre Principal de Maó, Spain's oldest opera house, hosts its historic lyric season organised by the Maó Opera Foundation and Friends of Maó Opera. In 2026 the 55th season programmes 'Un ballo in maschera' on 29 and 31 May.
imageAlt: The auditorium of Maó's Teatre Principal: red seats, gilded boxes and the painted curtain
